entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1. Heard Mr. P. J. Barman, learned counsel for the appellant.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the National Insurance Company Limited impugning the judgment and order dated 02.01.2026 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 1, Kamrup(M), in MAC Case No. 1223/2018 whereby the appellant was directed to pay a compensation amount of Rs.15,96,700/- along with an interest at the rate of 6% per annum to the claimant/respondent.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 1, Kamrup(M)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. I have perused the grounds taken in the memo of appeal and have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.

5. Let the records of MAC Case No. 1223/2018 be called for from the concerned tribunal.
6.
The Registry shall take steps for requisitioning the records.
The appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable 22nd of May, 2026.
